svg.text: (a) A CD is a reflection grating
violet bends least, red most: sin θ = mλ/d
(b) A soap film: two reflections interfere
Ray 2 travels about 2t farther than ray 1:
in step = bright color, out of step = dark.
reflected color vs. film thickness (computed, n = 1.33)
thinner than ~30 nm: the two reflections cancel
for every color, so the film looks black
